name: guardrails-ai/guardrails
description: Open-source Python framework for adding programmable guardrails to LLM applications — runs input/output validation guards detecting and mitigating risk types including injection attacks and harmful content, with a hub of pre-built validators and REST API deployment.
score_rationale: Widely adopted LLM safety enforcement framework with 6.6k stars, actively maintained through March 2026, and Apache-2.0 licensed for enterprise use.
summary: Framework for validating LLM inputs and outputs against structured schemas
